WITH filtered_processing AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    sp.memusagegb,
    sp.procgpu,
    sp.proccpu,
    s.entrystat
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8
),
per_site_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    entrystat,
    AVG(memusagegb) as avg_ram,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN procgpu IS NOT NULL AND proccpu IS NOT NULL AND proccpu > 0
        THEN CAST(procgpu AS REAL) / CAST(proccpu AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM filtered_processing
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) as avg_of_site_avg_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_avg_gpu_cpu
FROM per_site_avg
GROUP BY entrystat
ORDER BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: "whose site code matches a site" means zoneref must exist as a zoneregistry in the sites table
Rows with proccpu = 0 are excluded from GPU-to-CPU ratio calculations (division by zero prevention)
Two-stage aggregation: first compute per-site averages grouped by (zoneref, entrystat), then average those site-level values by entrystat alone
